about.subtitle: Meet the experienced practitioner behind our clinic's reputation for excellence
about.desc: Dr. Hassan founded DentalCare+ with a single mission: to make premium dental care accessible, pain-free, and lasting. His expertise spans implantology, cosmetic dentistry, and complex restorations. Every treatment plan is crafted individually — because no two smiles are alike.
about.credentials: 15+ years of specialized clinical practice, thousands of successful cases. Internationally accredited with the highest standards of professional trust and verified expertise.

services.subtitle: Comprehensive dental solutions — from prevention to full-mouth rehabilitation — all under one roof

crownBridges.title: Crowns & Bridges
crownBridges.desc: Restore strength and symmetry to your smile. Our precision-crafted crowns protect damaged teeth, while bridges seamlessly replace one or more missing teeth for a natural, lasting result.

dentalFilling.title: Tooth-Coloured Fillings
dentalFilling.desc: Say farewell to cavities and metal fillings. We use advanced composite materials that blend invisibly with your natural teeth, restoring both function and aesthetics in a single visit.

dentalImplants.title: Dental Implants
dentalImplants.desc: The gold standard in tooth replacement. Our titanium implants fuse naturally with your jawbone, offering a permanent, stable solution that looks, feels, and functions just like a natural tooth.

preventiveTreatment.title: Preventive Care
preventiveTreatment.desc: Your strongest defence against dental problems. From fluoride treatments to protective sealants, we help you maintain a healthy mouth and stop issues before they start.

accurateDiagnosis.title: Precision Diagnosis
accurateDiagnosis.desc: Accurate treatment starts with accurate diagnosis. We use the latest digital imaging and clinical technology to identify problems early and design effective, minimally invasive treatment plans.

removableDenture.title: Removable Dentures
removableDenture.desc: Regain the confidence to eat, speak, and smile freely. Our custom-fitted partial and full dentures are crafted for comfort and a natural appearance that suits your unique facial structure.

rootCanal.title: Root Canal Treatment
rootCanal.desc: Modern root canal therapy is virtually painless. We clear the infection, relieve your discomfort, and save the natural tooth — so you leave feeling far better than when you arrived.

scalingPolishing.title: Scale & Polish
scalingPolishing.desc: A brighter, fresher smile starts here. Our professional cleaning removes built-up plaque and tartar, eliminates surface stains, and gives your teeth the thorough clean your toothbrush simply can't.

veneers.title: Porcelain Veneers
veneers.desc: Transform your smile in just two visits. Our ultra-thin porcelain veneers are custom-designed to correct chips, gaps, discolouration, and irregular shapes — for a naturally stunning result.

digitalXray.title: Digital X-Ray
digitalXray.desc: Sharper images, faster answers, minimal radiation. Our digital X-ray sensors provide exceptionally detailed views of your teeth and bone, enabling faster, more accurate diagnoses every time.

panoramicXray.title: Panoramic X-Ray
panoramicXray.desc: A complete picture of your oral health in a single scan. Our panoramic X-ray captures your full jaw, all teeth, the TMJ joint, and surrounding bone — giving us the full clinical picture.

pediatric.title: Paediatric Dentistry
pediatric.desc: Gentle, child-friendly care for your little ones. Our paediatric-trained dentists create a calm, positive experience that builds healthy dental habits children carry throughout their lives.

orthodontics.title: Orthodontics
orthodontics.desc: Straighten your teeth and align your bite with confidence. We offer both traditional braces and modern clear aligner systems tailored to your lifestyle, timeline, and aesthetic goals.

dentalLaser.title: Laser Dentistry
dentalLaser.desc: Precision treatment with minimal discomfort and faster healing. Our dental laser technology is used for gum contouring, cavity treatment, and whitening — a truly modern approach to dental care.

smileMakeover.title: Smile Makeover
smileMakeover.desc: Your dream smile, fully realised. A smile makeover combines the right mix of cosmetic procedures — veneers, whitening, reshaping — to deliver a result that's uniquely, beautifully yours.

minorSurgeries.title: Minor Oral Surgeries
minorSurgeries.desc: Safe, comfortable, in-chair procedures performed under local anaesthesia. Whether it's a tooth extraction, cyst removal, or gum correction — our surgical team ensures a smooth, worry-free experience.

cbct.title: 3D CBCT Scanning
cbct.desc: The most comprehensive view of your dental anatomy. Our CBCT scanner provides precise 3D images of bone depth, nerve pathways, and sinus structures — essential for implant planning and complex cases.

faq.subtitle: Answers to the things our patients ask most often
faq.q1: How long will I wait before seeing the dentist?
faq.a1: We operate on an appointment-only, zero-wait policy. When you arrive at your scheduled time, you'll be seen immediately — no sitting in a waiting room.
faq.a2: Yes, we work with a wide range of insurance providers. Please contact our reception team before your visit and we'll confirm your coverage details.
faq.q3: How do I book an appointment?
faq.a3: Simply use the 'Book Appointment' button on this page. Fill in your details and we'll confirm your slot via WhatsApp — usually within minutes.
faq.q4: How do you ensure instruments are sterile and safe?
faq.a4: Every single instrument used in our clinics is sterilised using medical-grade autoclave equipment, following strict international protocols — for every patient, every time.
faq.q5: Where are your clinic branches located?
faq.a5: We have three conveniently located branches across Cairo: Nasr City (Makram Ebeid Street), Maadi (El Lasilky Street), and Mokattam (Central Plateau).
